data.description: A sought-after community for sports, leisure, and living.

data.answer:
Dubai Sports City is a vibrant, multi-venue sports complex located in Dubai. The area boasts a wide array of amenities and facilities tailored to support an active lifestyle. Dubai Sports City is home to several sports academies offering training in cricket, football, rugby, and more, nurturing young talents and providing professional-level coaching.

The community is also enriched with schools, healthcare facilities, and retail outlets, making it a self-contained environment ideal for families and sports enthusiasts alike. Its strategic location provides easy access to Dubai’s major highways, enhancing connectivity to the rest of the city and making it a sought-after destination for living and leisure.

In Dubai Sports City, a diverse mix of residents, from growing families to young singles, as well as renters and investors, have a variety of housing options to choose from, including studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom Dubai Sports City apartments. These rental units vary in style from modern and contemporary to traditional Arabic designs, catering to different tastes and preferences.

Among the top rental properties in Dubai Sports City, the Elite Sports Residences stand out for their popularity. This complex comprises several towers throughout the area, all equipped with amenities such as gyms, swimming pools, and ample parking spaces. Other notable buildings include Giovanni Boutique Suites, Canal Residence West, Red Residence, and Global Golf Residence Dubai Sports City.

Property prices in Sports City remain relatively affordable when compared to other parts of the city. For example, a studio in Hera Tower can be purchased for around AED 300k, while the starting annual rent for a studio in Sports City is approximately AED 35k. Elite Sports Residence offers mid-sized studio flats starting at AED 25k per year. Royal Residence and Spirit Tower are also among the top choices for renting studios, with spaces averaging around 325 sq. ft. Other properties include:

Prime Villas Dubai Sports City: Prime Villas offers luxurious and spacious villas, ideally suited for families looking for premium living spaces with a host of modern amenities.

Stadium Point Dubai Sports City: Stadium Point is a residential and commercial tower providing panoramic views of the cricket stadium, designed for those who enjoy vibrant sports and community activities.

The Bridge Dubai Sports City: The Bridge combines residential and commercial spaces in a unique architectural form, offering state-of-the-art facilities and a dynamic lifestyle.

The Matrix Dubai Sports City: The Matrix is known for its futuristic design and premium apartments, providing residents with high-end amenities and a modern living experience.

Off-plan Properties in Dubai Sports City

Golf Vista Heights by London Gate

Starting at AED 450K, Golf Vista Heights is poised to redefine luxury living in Dubai Sports City. Developed by London Gate, this striking development offers studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, ideal for those seeking a blend of luxury and convenience. Set to complete in 2027, residents will wake up to the lush greens of the golf courses and enjoy top-notch amenities.

Sportz by Danube Properties

With a starting price of AED 590K, Sportz is an innovative twin-tower project by Danube Properties that introduces a modern twist to urban living. Available in 1, 2, and 3-bedroom configurations, this development caters to dynamic lifestyles, emphasizing upscale living within a vibrant community. Its unique design and comprehensive amenities set it apart as a hallmark of contemporary housing.

Azizi Grand by Azizi Developments

Azizi Developments presents Azizi Grand, a luxury residential complex in Dubai Sports City, with prices starting at AED 797K. Scheduled for completion in 2026, the complex includes studios, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments. Azizi Grand combines sophisticated design with the tranquility of green landscapes, offering a serene yet connected lifestyle.

Samana Golf Views by Samana Developers

Starting from AED 820K, Samana Golf Views offers an opulent lifestyle with studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. This development is designed to provide a luxurious living experience in the heart of Dubai Sports City. Residents will enjoy expansive living spaces and easy access to sports facilities and leisure options, promoting a lavish and active lifestyle.

Buying a Property in Dubai Sports City

Investors will find Dubai Sports City properties for sale an attractive option. Dubai Sports City studio for sale has an average asking price of approximately AED 334k, while one-bedroom apartments are typically priced at around AED 486k. Two-bedroom apartments, averaging 1,200 sq. ft., can be purchased for about AED 750k, with Olympic Park and Global Golf Residence being noteworthy options that offer stunning golf course views. Three-bedroom apartments in the area go for an average of AED 974k.

For those interested in larger living spaces, townhomes and villas are available throughout Dubai Sports City. The community features spacious residences with private parking and outdoor areas, ideal for those who prefer living in close-knit communities. A three-bedroom townhouse may be purchased for AED 1.8M, while a four-bedroom townhouse starts at AED 2.2M. The price for four-bedroom villas begins at AED 1.8M and can reach up to AED 2.4M, varying by size and construction date. Meanwhile, five-bedroom villas are priced around AED 3.9M, and luxurious six-bedroom villas are available for an average of AED 8.45M.

Rental Properties in Dubai Sports City

Looking for rental properties in Dubai Sports City? The typical rent for a studio apartment in Dubai Sports City is AED 24k annually, with available spaces ranging from 350 sq. ft. to 570 sq. ft. Cricket Tower offers spacious studios at this rate and stands 15 stories high with 140 units, particularly appealing to young expatriates. For those needing more space, one-bedroom apartments are available for rent between AED 26k and AED 55k per year, with variations depending on the specific project, the size of the apartment, the view, and the floor level.

Larger families or those desiring more room might consider two-bedroom apartments available for AED 51k annually, while three-bedroom apartments generally rent for about AED 70k.

For independent living, Dubai Sports City offers a selection of three to six-bedroom villas. Gated communities like Victory Heights and Bloomingdale feature clusters of townhouses with four and five-bedroom options ranging from 2,300 sq. ft. to 3,300 sq. ft. The average rent for a three-bedroom villa is AED 110k, and for those looking for even more space, four-bedroom villas average AED 137k annually. Larger, five-bedroom villas start at AED 197k, and rents can rise to AED 326k for expansive six-bedroom homes in the area.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Sports City?

data.answer:
Life in Dubai Sports City offers a dynamic and sporty lifestyle, ideal for both individuals and families who enjoy being active and social. The community is designed around the concept of a healthy, active lifestyle, with a plethora of sports facilities, including stadiums, sports academies, and fitness centers that cater to a range of activities from cricket to golf.

Public Transportation in Dubai Sports City

Public transportation options in Dubai Sports City are currently somewhat limited, with no direct metro access. However, the area is serviced by a few bus routes which connect residents to nearby metro stations. Near Dubai Sports City metro station is Dubai Internet City Metro Station, about a 12-minute drive away. Many residents prefer using personal vehicles or taxis for greater convenience and accessibility.

Supermarkets in Dubai Sports City

Residents have access to several supermarkets within Dubai Sports City that cater to daily needs, including Carrefour Market and Spinneys. There are also several smaller grocery stores scattered throughout the area, ensuring that essentials are always within reach.

Shopping Malls in and Near the Dubai Sports City Area

While Dubai Sports City itself does not host large shopping malls, it is conveniently located near several major shopping destinations. The Mall of the Emirates, one of Dubai’s largest shopping centers, is just a short drive away, offering a wide range of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Additionally, City Centre Me’aisem provides a variety of shops and services for everyday shopping needs.

Schools and Nurseries in Dubai Sports City

The community provides several educational options, ensuring that families have convenient access to quality education. Gems Metropole is one of the most well-known schools in the vicinity. Other notable institutions include Victory Heights Primary School, which follows the British curriculum, and the Wonder Years Nursery, which offers early childhood education. These facilities are complemented by various other nurseries and schools in and around the area, catering to diverse educational needs.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Dubai Sports City

Dubai Sports City houses a mosque within the community for daily prayers and religious gatherings. For other faiths, there are several churches and a Hindu temple located in the nearby areas of Al Barsha and Jebel Ali, respectively. These places of worship are within a 20-30 minute drive, providing easy access for residents.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Dubai Sports City Area

For medical services, Dubai Sports City is near several clinics and hospitals. The community itself has basic medical facilities, and more specialized care is available at Mediclinic Parkview Hospital and Saudi German Hospital, both within a 15-minute drive. These healthcare facilities offer a range of services, from emergency care to specialist treatments.

Dubai Sports City Location & Nearby Areas


Dubai Sports City is strategically located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311), making it easily accessible from various parts of Dubai. It is approximately:

  • 15 minutes from Al Barsha and Jumeirah Village Circle.
  • 20 minutes from Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach Residence.
  • 25 minutes from Dubai Mall and Downtown Dubai.
  • 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport.

Things to Do in Dubai Sports City:

Dubai Sports City is a paradise for sports enthusiasts, featuring facilities for cricket, football, golf, and more. The Dubai International Stadium hosts regular international cricket matches, while the Els Club offers a world-class golfing experience. For fitness enthusiasts, there are numerous gyms and fitness centers. Families can enjoy community parks, and the area frequently hosts sports events and community activities, providing entertainment for all ages.

Dubai Sports City Restaurants & Bars

The area boasts a variety of dining options, ranging from casual eateries to upscale restaurants. Popular spots include The Big Easy Bar & Grill at The Els Club, offering a relaxed dining atmosphere with a golf course view, and Kickers Sports Bar, a lively venue for watching sports events. There are also various cafes and fast-food outlets scattered throughout the community, catering to diverse tastes and preferences.

Beaches Near Dubai Sports City

While Dubai Sports City itself is inland, several beautiful beaches are easily accessible within a short drive. JBR Beach and Kite Beach are both about a 20-minute drive away, offering sandy shores, water sports, and vibrant beachside activities.

Hotels in Dubai Sports City

For visitors or those seeking staycation options, there are a few hotels in and near Dubai Sports City. The nearby Ghaya Grand Hotel and Park Inn by Radisson offer comfortable accommodations with modern amenities, suitable for both business and leisure travelers. These hotels provide easy access to the sports facilities and the rest of Dubai’s attractions.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Dubai Sports City Dubai

Close to Dubai Sports City, several attractions add to the appeal of the area. Global Village, a cultural and entertainment destination showcasing international pavilions and events, is just a short drive away. The Miracle Garden, famed for its stunning floral displays, offers a picturesque retreat nearby. Additionally, IMG Worlds of Adventure, one of the world’s largest indoor theme parks, is located within a convenient distance, providing thrilling rides and entertainment for all ages.

Outdoor Activities, Salons, and Gyms

For outdoor enthusiasts, Dubai Sports City offers a range of activities. The community’s own sports facilities provide ample opportunities for cricket, football, golf, and more. The cycling and jogging tracks are perfect for those who prefer outdoor fitness routines. Nearby, the Jumeirah Golf Estates and Dubai Autodrome offer golfing and motorsport adventures, respectively.

Salons and wellness centers within and around Dubai Sports City cater to those looking to relax and rejuvenate. Tips & Toes and The Nail Spa are popular choices for beauty treatments. For fitness buffs, aside from the sports facilities, several gyms like Fitness First and Fit Republik offer a variety of fitness classes and state-of-the-art equipment.

One important factor to consider before moving to Dubai Sports City is the transportation options. While the area is strategically located near major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, public transportation options within Dubai Sports City itself are limited. This might be a concern for those who rely on public transit for daily commuting.

Prospective residents should consider having a personal vehicle or be prepared to use taxis and ride-sharing services to ensure convenient access to other parts of Dubai. Additionally, planning around peak traffic times may be necessary to avoid delays when traveling to and from the community.

What kind of sports facilities are available in Dubai Sports City?

Dubai Sports City is equipped with a variety of sports facilities including the Dubai International Stadium for cricket, a rugby park, several football fields, and The Els Club for golf enthusiasts. The community also hosts various sports academies offering professional coaching in sports like cricket, football, and tennis.

Are there schools and educational facilities in Dubai Sports City?

Yes, Dubai Sports City has several educational institutions catering to different age groups. Notable ones include Victory Heights Primary School, which follows the British curriculum, and the Wonder Years Nursery, providing early childhood education. The area also has learning centers that offer after-school activities and tutoring.

What are the dining options in Dubai Sports City?

The area offers a range of dining options from casual to fine dining. Notable spots include The Big Easy Bar & Grill at The Els Club and Kickers Sports Bar. There are also various cafes and fast-food outlets throughout the community, catering to diverse tastes and dietary preferences.

What type of residential options are available in Dubai Sports City?

Dubai Sports City offers a mix of residential options ranging from affordable studio apartments to luxurious villas. The area is known for its family-friendly environment and provides various accommodations that suit different budgets and lifestyle needs.

How far is Dubai Sports City from major attractions in Dubai?

Dubai Sports City is strategically located and well-connected by major highways, making it relatively easy to access Dubai’s major attractions. It’s about a 20-minute drive to Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach Residence, 25 minutes to Downtown Dubai and Dubai Mall, and about 30 minutes from Dubai International Airport.

data.content:
Dubai Sports City is a vibrant multi-purpose community that spans over 50 million sq. ft. It features state-of-the-art sporting facilities, including stadiums, sports academies, and residential developments.

Key highlights of the area include the multi-purpose Dubai International Stadium, which has hosted numerous international cricket matches, and The Els Club - an 18-hole championship golf course.

The district also offers a diverse mix of housing options, from luxurious villas to high-rise apartment buildings. Dubai Sports City is one of the freehold areas in Dubai, which is easily accessible via Al Khail Road and Hessa Street.

nodes.title: Aspirz
nodes.about:
Aspirz by Danube is a sophisticated residential and commercial offering located in the heart of Dubai Sports City, developed by Danube Properties. The project features fully furnished and convertible studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments alongside premium office spaces, ideal for professionals and families seeking modern living and work environments.

Designed for those pursuing lifestyle convenience and investment potential, Aspirz by Danube offers hotel-style services, upscale amenities, and an attractive location. With a strategic 70/30 post-handover payment plan and appealing price point, the development ensures high ROI while delivering exceptional quality of life to its residents.

Developed by the renowned LEOS Developments, the project delivers a unique lifestyle where sports, education, and urban conveniences are just steps away. Whether you're an investor or end-user, Hadley Heights 2 by LEOS Developments for sale is a prime choice in a growing, high-demand area.

nodes.title: Binghatti Haven
nodes.about:
Binghatti Haven at Dubai Sports City is an exquisite residential development by Binghatti Developers, offering 501 studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Each residence is thoughtfully designed, blending luxury with functionality, perfect for both families and professionals. The project, featuring 26 residential floors, is strategically located near Motor City, Dubai Hills, and City Centre Meaisem, ensuring easy access to key destinations.

Haven by Binghatti boasts a striking architectural design with sleek lines and modern interiors. Residents enjoy premium amenities such as basketball courts, a green maze, kids' aqua pool, and a smart home system. The development features spacious living areas with expansive windows, offering stunning views of Dubai Sports City.

Binghatti Haven’s prime location provides direct access to major road networks and public transport, making it a highly desirable place to live. Investing in Binghatti Haven offers both comfort and luxury, with a promise of strong long-term value. With its superior design and strategic position, Haven is a true symbol of modern living in Dubai.

nodes.title: MAG 777
nodes.about:
MAG 777 is the latest stunning development by MAG Property Development, bringing a perfect blend of modern design and luxury amenities to the heart of Dubai Sports City. This 22-floor residential tower features 252 units with studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, each crafted to elevate your living experience.

Designed for those seeking a balanced lifestyle, MAG 777 provides flexible payment plans and competitive starting prices, making it an ideal option for both investors and homeowners.

nodes.title: Venetian
nodes.about:
Venetian is a 20-storey residential development that is part of the Canal Residence West project in Dubai Sports City, Dubai.

Venetian offers studios and apartments with 1 to 3 bedrooms. Studios have a semi-enclosed modern kitchen, a spacious balcony, and a bedroom with attached bathroom. The apartments have a modern kitchen with appliances, spacious lounge, balcony and en-suite bedrooms. The three-bedroom apartments have an additional maid's room and laundry room.

Venetian Residence residents have access to many services and amenities: covered parking, high-speed lifts, 24-hour security, central air conditioning, business centre for business meetings, state-of-the-art gym, swimming pool, health club, sauna, barbecue area, ground floor shops, children's playground, beauty salon, pharmacy, hairdresser, 24-hour concierge services.

Within walking distance of Venetian are Renaissance School and Victory Heights Dwight School, The Wonder Years Nursery, Eupepsia Medical Clinic, Dhafar Park, Eisbej Park and Qesad Park. European Building and Arena Tower bus stops are a 5-minute walk away. Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum Airport are a 30-minute drive from the residence.
